categories.main_business_segments: OHARA INC. operates two main business segments: the Optical Business and the Electronics Business. The Optical Business focuses on manufacturing and selling optical glass materials and lens materials for optical equipment. The Electronics Business produces and sells high-homogeneity optical glass for semiconductor lithography equipment, ultra-low expansion glass ceramics, and quartz glass for electronics applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced glass material design, high-temperature melting, and precision forming technologies developed over nearly 90 years. Key production methods include high-homogeneity glass melting, precision pressing, and polishing for optical and specialty glass, as well as the development of glass ceramics and solid electrolyte materials for next-generation batteries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: OHARA serves manufacturers of digital cameras, interchangeable camera lenses, semiconductor lithography equipment, and other optical and electronics device makers. Major end markets include the digital imaging, semiconductor, AR/XR, and advanced electronics industries, with significant sales to companies like Canon.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales bases in Japan, Taiwan, China, Malaysia, the United States, Germany, and Hong Kong. Sales are well-diversified across Japan, China, Taiwan, other Asian countries, the US, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: OHARA is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain, supplying advanced glass materials and semi-finished products to downstream manufacturers of optical and electronic devices. The company also engages in some downstream activities through value-added processing and finished product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the business foundation, exploring new businesses, and deepening existing operations. R&D focuses on high-value-added optical glass, advanced glass ceramics, solid electrolytes for batteries, low-dielectric glass for PCBs, and environmentally friendly production methods. The company is also pursuing collaborations in AR/XR and battery materials to drive future growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of glass materials, processed optical components, and specialty glass products to B2B customers. The company also earns revenue from licensing and collaborative development in certain advanced material fields.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OHARA competes with global specialty glass manufacturers such as Schott and Corning, as well as regional players in Asia. The company is recognized for its technological expertise and high-quality products, maintaining a strong position in niche markets like optical glass for cameras and semiconductor equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending October 2024, consolidated sales were approximately 27.9 billion yen, with net income attributable to parent company shareholders of about 1.57 billion yen. The company has shown stable profitability and asset growth, with a strong equity ratio (77.6%) and a workforce of 1,454 employees. Growth is driven by the electronics segment, particularly in semiconductor-related products.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OHARA emphasizes its ability to deliver high-quality, high-performance glass materials tailored to advanced optical and electronics applications. Its differentiation lies in proprietary material design, precision manufacturing, and responsiveness to emerging technology trends such as AR/XR and next-generation batteries, enabling customers to achieve superior product performance.
